*F-aPKE* (Adaptively secure non-interactive PKE) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Camenisch, Lehmann, Neven, and Samelin. [*UC-secure non-interactive public-key encryption*](https://doi.org/10.1109/CSF.2017.23). In 30th IEEE Computer Security Foundations Symposium (CSF), pages 217–233, 2017.
- Canetti, Halevi, and Katz. [*Adaptively secure non-interactive public-key encryption*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2004/317). In 2nd Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), 2005.
